recipe.title: Masala fish, bok choy, mango salsa
recipe.notes: This is from Nadia Lim's book, Easy Weeknight Meals.
recipe.prep: Get some coconut rice under way, and bring a full kettle to the boil.

i.n: mango (or 1.5 C frozen mango), finely diced

method.s: For the salsa, combine mango, chili, spring onion, coriander, fish or soy sayce, lime zest and lime juice. Set aside.
Pat fish fillets dry with paper towels and remove any remaining scales or bones.
Combine salt and garam masala and rub onto fish on both sides.

Heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying-pan on medium to high heat. Cook fish, skin side down, for about two minutes or until skin is crispy. Flip over and cook until just cooked through, about one minute.
Place bok choy in a bowl and pour over boiling water to cover. Leave for about two minutes until wilted and bright green.
Drain and toss gently with sesame oil and soy sauce.
Serve with coconut rice. Top with bok choy, a piece of fish and mango salsa.
